app.title: VoxFusion
tooltip.header.settings: Open global application settings such as proxy and HuggingFace token.
tooltip.header.log_mode: Normal shows key stages and errors only. Debug shows the full structured pipeline log.
tooltip.header.language: Change the GUI language. The selection is saved for the next launch.
tooltip.logs.panel: Runtime log output. In Normal mode this pane shows only milestones and errors.
live.status.default: Select devices/model and click Start or Record Audio.
live.status.file_only_model: {model_name} is available for file transcription only.
live.status.file_only_model_action: {model_name} currently supports file transcription only. Use Record Audio + File Transcription.
live.status.select_device_capture: Select at least one device to start capture.
live.status.select_device_record: Select at least one device to record.
tooltip.live.devices:
Select one or more audio devices for capture.

Microphone — records your voice.
System/Loopback — captures audio playing on your PC.
Selecting both captures both sources simultaneously.
tooltip.live.model:
ASR model for live transcription.

Whisper Small — balanced default, multilingual.
Whisper Tiny — fastest, lowest accuracy.
Note: GigaAM and Parakeet are file-only models.
tooltip.live.language:
Language spoken in the audio.
Specifying the language is faster and more accurate than Auto Detect.
tooltip.live.translate: Translate transcription to this language code (for example 'en' or 'de'). Leave blank to disable translation.
tooltip.live.start: Start live audio capture and real-time transcription.
tooltip.live.stop: Stop the running live capture or recording session.
tooltip.live.pause: Pause or resume the current audio recording.
tooltip.live.record_audio: Record raw audio to a file without transcription. The saved file can be transcribed later.
tooltip.live.record_format:
Audio format for recorded files.

wav — uncompressed.
ogg — compressed.
opus — smallest size, good quality.
mp3 — wide compatibility.
tooltip.live.save: Save the current live transcript to a file.
tooltip.live.summary: Live pipeline summary: preprocessing queue, ASR in-flight work, and dropped chunks.
tooltip.live.segment_counter: Number of transcript segments currently shown in the live table.
tooltip.live.status: Current status of live capture or recording.
tooltip.live.table: Live transcript table with timestamps, source labels, original text, and optional translation.
file.banner.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg not found. Video files will not work correctly.
file.workflow.title: Workflow: Record -> Transcribe -> Send transcript to Open WebUI
file.workflow.step1: Step 1: Choose a file or record audio, then transcribe it.
file.workflow.step2_ready_recorded: Step 2: Ready to transcribe recorded audio: {file_name}
file.workflow.step3: Step 3: Review the transcript and send it to Open WebUI.
file.table.speaker: Speaker
file.status.hf_token_required: Speaker detection requires a HuggingFace token (Settings).
file.status.cleared_list: Cleared file list. Add files and click Transcribe Queue.
file.status.cleared: Cleared. Add files and click Transcribe Queue.
file.status.queue_duplicate: Selected files are already in the queue.
file.status.loaded_models_cached: Server model list is unavailable, using a cached list of {count} model(s). Error: {error}
file.status.min_max_invalid: Error: Min speakers must be less than or equal to max speakers.
file.status.select_and_transcribe: Select a file and click Transcribe.
file.status.ready_transcript: Step 3: Transcript ready. Saved to {file_name}. Send it to Open WebUI or use Save... for another format.
file.status.finished_no_speech: Transcription finished, but no speech segments were found. Transcript file was not created.
file.status.queue_finished: Queue finished: {done} done, {errors} error(s), {cancelled} cancelled, {queued} waiting.
tooltip.file.current: The file that will be transcribed next from the queue selection.
tooltip.file.add_files: Add one or more audio or video files to the transcription queue.
tooltip.file.remove: Remove the selected file from the queue.
tooltip.file.clear_list: Clear the full queued file list.
tooltip.file.queue_table: Queued files. Duration and size may appear shortly after insertion if metadata is still loading in the background.
tooltip.file.model:
ASR model used for transcription.

GigaAM v3 — best accuracy for Russian.
Whisper Small — balanced multilingual default.
Whisper Large — best multilingual quality, slowest.
Parakeet V3 — fast, 25 European languages.
tooltip.file.language:
Language spoken in the audio.
Auto Detect is slower but automatic.
tooltip.file.quality:
Transcription quality preset.

Fast — fastest.
Balanced — default tradeoff.
Quality — highest accuracy.
tooltip.file.diarization:
Controls how speakers are identified in the transcript.

none — skip diarization.
channel — assign by audio source.
ml — AI model via pyannote.audio.
hybrid — channel-first with ML fallback.
auto — best available strategy.
tooltip.file.diarization_help:
none = skip diarization.
ml = pyannote AI diarization.
channel = mic vs. system audio.
auto = best available strategy.
tooltip.file.speaker_preset:
Number of speakers in the recording.
Auto lets the AI estimate it.
Custom uses the Min/Max fields below.
tooltip.file.speaker_help:
Specifying the speaker count can speed up ML diarization.
Use Detect to estimate the count from a 2-minute sample.
tooltip.file.min_speakers: Minimum expected number of speakers. Leave blank for automatic detection.
tooltip.file.max_speakers: Maximum expected number of speakers. Leave blank for automatic detection.
tooltip.file.detect: Estimate the number of speakers from a short sample of the selected file.
tooltip.file.download_model: Pre-download the selected ASR model to the local model cache.
tooltip.file.transcribe_queue: Start transcription of the queued files using the current settings.
tooltip.file.progress: Transcription progress for the active file.
tooltip.file.status: Current status of the file transcription workflow.
tooltip.file.artifact: Path to the latest auto-saved transcript file.
tooltip.file.results_table: Transcript results for the active file with timestamps and speaker labels.
tooltip.file.save: Save the current file transcription to TXT or SRT.
tooltip.file.segment_counter: Number of transcript segments currently shown for the active file.
llm.status.no_transcript: No transcript available. Complete Step 2 first.
tooltip.llm.url: Base URL of the Open WebUI or compatible API endpoint.
tooltip.llm.refresh_models: Fetch available models from the configured Open WebUI endpoint.
tooltip.llm.model: Target LLM model used to process the transcript.
tooltip.llm.api_key: Optional API key for the configured Open WebUI endpoint.
tooltip.llm.prompt: Choose a prompt template for transcript processing.
tooltip.llm.send: Send the current transcript to the selected LLM.
tooltip.llm.copy: Copy the LLM output to the clipboard.
tooltip.llm.status: Current status of the LLM request.
tooltip.llm.output: Streaming or completed response returned by the configured LLM.

settings.label.use_system_proxy: Use system proxy  (Windows automatic / environment variables)
